name: Muntz Reveals the Monster of Paradise Falls
description: Muntz stands on stage in a crowded auditorium, beside a large curtained object. He announces, 'Gentlemen, I give you: the Monster of Paradise Falls!' and pulls the drape away to reveal a giant bird skeleton. The audience gasps and murmurs in amazement. Young Carl leans forward in his seat at the small town theater, eyes wide. Soon after, scientists step forward to examine the bones, their expressions skeptical. They question whether the skeleton is real. The National Explorers Society declares the find a fraud and removes Muntz’s portrait from the wall of honored explorers. A badge is ripped from his jacket. Muntz stands silent, then later addresses a crowd at an airfield, vowing to return to Paradise Falls and capture the beast alive. He raises a thumb in his signature gesture as the dirigible behind him begins to lift into the sky.

Before a gathered crowd, he declares he will return to Paradise Falls and capture the beast alive. He repeats his promise, vowing not to come back until he succeeds. The crowd cheers as he gives a final thumbs up from the cockpit. The dirigible lifts off into the sky, carrying him away on his quest.

name: Young Carl Watches Muntz's Adventure Newsreel
description: Eight-year-old Carl Fredricksen sits in a small town theater, eyes wide with wonder as a newsreel plays on the screen. On film, the explorer Charles Muntz descends a gangplank to cheering crowds, his dogs following closely behind. The camera shows the luxurious interior of Muntz’s massive airship, where one dog endures a mechanized bath and another runs on a treadmill wearing an electrode helmet. Muntz strikes a heroic pose and declares, "Adventure is out there!" Young Carl, wearing a leather flight helmet and goggles just like his idol, responds by giving a thumbs up. The newsreel continues with Muntz unveiling a giant bird skeleton to an amazed audience, only for scientists to later challenge its authenticity. Muntz is stripped of his Explorer's Society badge, his portrait removed from the wall. Standing by his airship at an airfield, Muntz vows to return to Paradise Falls and capture the beast alive. As he gives a final thumbs up from the cockpit, the airship rises into the sky. In the darkened theater, Carl watches, transfixed, his face lit with awe.

Carl declines, then points across the lot to a man in a suit and tells Tom to inform his boss that the construction crew is damaging his house. He takes a megaphone from Tom and shouts at the man in the suit to take a bath. Tom quickly grabs the megaphone back, distancing himself from Carl. name: Ellie Shares Her Adventure Book with Carl
description: Ellie and Carl huddle under a blanket tent with a flashlight. Ellie whispers that she is about to show Carl something she has never shown anyone else. She makes him swear to keep it secret and cross his heart. He does. She reveals a reused photo album titled "My Adventure Book." Inside, the first page shows a picture of explorer Charles Muntz. Ellie says she wants to go to South America when she grows up. She turns to a map, then to an engraving of a large waterfall with a hand-drawn picture of her clubhouse glued to the top. She reads the caption: "Paradise Falls, a land lost in time." She tells Carl she ripped the page from a library book, and he gasps. She plans to move her clubhouse next to the falls and discover what lives there. She flips to a page labeled "STUFF I'M GOING TO DO" and then shows the blank pages that follow, saying they are for the adventures she will have. She closes the book, looking disappointed, saying she doesn’t know how she’ll get to Paradise Falls. Carl looks at his toy dirigible. Ellie exclaims that he can take them there in a blimp. She makes him promise, and he crosses his heart again. She accepts his promise, tells him not to back out, then says goodbye and jumps out the window. She pops her head back in and says Carl doesn’t talk much, but she likes him. Carl watches her go, rests his head on his balloon, and the balloon pops.

name: Ellie and Carl Make a Promise
description: Ellie pulls out her Adventure Book and shows Carl a picture of Paradise Falls, where she dreams of living one day. She asks Carl to swear he will take her there, demanding he cross his heart. Carl does. Ellie insists the promise is binding and tells him not to back out. Carl shakes his head to show he won’t. Satisfied, Ellie says goodbye and climbs out the window. As she leaves, she calls back, "Adventure is out there!!" Then she pops her head back in and says, "You know, you don't talk very much. I like you." Carl watches her go, resting his head on his balloon, which suddenly pops.

name: Ellie Proposes the Blimp Journey and Leaves
description: Ellie sees Carl's toy dirigible and suddenly grins. She grabs the toy, then points to the drawing of her clubhouse beside Paradise Falls in the Adventure Book. 'That's it! You can take us there in a blimp!' She holds out her hand, demanding a promise. 'Swear you'll take us. Cross your heart!' Carl crosses his heart. 'Good. You promised. No backing out.' He shakes his head firmly. 'Well, see you tomorrow, kid! Bye!' She hops up, climbs onto the windowsill, and jumps out, calling into the night, 'Adventure is out there!' She pops her head back in. 'You know, you don't talk very much. I like you.' She disappears again. Carl stares out the window, stunned. He leans his head gently against his balloon. It pops.

name: Russell Seeks the Assisting the Elderly Badge
description: Russell stands at Carl's door and introduces himself as a member of the Wilderness Explorers, Tribe 54, Sweatlodge 12. He shows Carl his sash, covered in badges, and points out one empty space. He explains that he needs the Assisting the Elderly badge to become a Senior Wilderness Explorer. With enthusiasm, he forms the Explorer sign with his hands—thumbs making a 'W' and fingers flaring like wings, then claws—and shouts, 'The wilderness must be explored! CAW-CAW! RAAAR!' The loud noise triggers Carl's hearing aid, causing him discomfort. Russell describes the upcoming ceremony where fathers come to pin on the badges. Carl, resigned, asks if he wants to assist an old person. Russell eagerly confirms, ready to begin.

name: Carl Sends Russell on a Snipe Hunt
description: Carl listens at the door, then opens it to find Russell, a young Wilderness Explorer, standing politely. Russell introduces himself and explains he needs to assist an elderly person to earn his Assisting the Elderly badge. Carl initially refuses, but when Russell blocks the door with his foot, he relents. He tells Russell about a made-up bird called a snipe that eats his azaleas and claims he is too frail to catch it. Russell eagerly offers to help. Carl says the snipe is hard to catch and must be lured by clapping three times. He tells Russell the snipe’s burrow is two blocks away. Russell runs off, clapping and calling for the snipe. Carl watches, then rolls his eyes as he starts to close the door.

name: Carl defends Ellie's mailbox from the construction crew
description: A construction truck backs up and crushes Ellie's mailbox. Carl rushes to the scene and shouts at the worker, demanding he stop. The worker apologizes and tries to fix the mailbox, but Carl grabs it and struggles to keep it away. The worker reaches for it, insisting he can help, but Carl hits him with his cane. The worker falls to the sidewalk, clutching his head, which is bleeding. Bystanders and other workers gather around. Carl backs away, still holding the damaged mailbox, and retreats into his house.

name: Ellie pilots a make-believe dirigible and spots a puppy
description: Ellie stands at the bicycle wheel she uses as a makeshift control panel, steering her imaginary dirigible through the air. She lifts a pair of Coke bottles tied together, using them as binoculars to scan the ground below. Her voice rings out with excitement as she announces a discovery: a puppy. She declares she will bring it back for science, then suddenly shifts focus as a storm appears on the horizon, yelling about lightning and hail. She pops up in front of Carl, interrupting his attention to the newspaper clippings on the wall.

name: Ellie Challenges Carl for Entry to the Explorer Club
description: Carl rounds the corner and sees Ellie, a freckled eight-year-old with wild red hair under a flight helmet, standing barefoot in an old house turned pretend dirigible cockpit. She steers a bicycle wheel, calling out weather conditions and commanding her hamster navigator to log the data. Using two Coke bottles tied together as binoculars, she spots something below and exclaims about rescuing a puppy for science—until a storm erupts in her imagination. She notices Carl, jumps in front of him, and demands to know what he’s doing. Startled, Carl screams and releases his balloon, which floats up through a hole in the ceiling and vanishes. Ellie circles him, accusing him of trespassing in her exclusive club, insisting only real explorers are allowed. She challenges him, asking if he has what it takes. Carl stammers, unable to respond. After a pause, she accepts him, welcomes him aboard, and offers her hand. He stands frozen. She removes her helmet, her hair springing out in tufts, and unpins a grape soda cap badge from her overalls, fastening it onto his shirt. She tells him they’re in the club now. She says she saw where his balloon went and urges him to come retrieve it. As she strides out, she returns, introduces herself as Ellie, and takes his hand, pulling him along as he blushes.
